review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: The complete 1536x1024 H4 plate and its generation prompt were inspected independently.
review_views.notes: Open sea, branching delta, forest river, circular city, coastal port, roads, rocky highland, fields, and quiet corridors are all present in the requested arrangement.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The final RGB PNG was inspected at native 1536x1024 resolution.
review_views.notes: Parchment, dusty-blue water, copperplate ink, terrain separation, and micro-detail are exceptionally strong, but architectural and rocky features retain pictorial depth cues.

review_views.label: 25%縮小
review_views.evidence: H4 was downscaled to 384x256 with Lanczos and inspected as a complete plate.
review_views.notes: Sea, forest, delta, city, port, highland, roads, and fields remain immediately identifiable with strong macro-contrast.

review_views.label: 50%縮小
review_views.evidence: H4 was downscaled to 768x512 and compared side by side with Candidate B1.
review_views.notes: Route hierarchy and terrain classes remain clean, and the H4 palette and hand-inked density closely follow B1.

review_views.label: 200%拡大
review_views.evidence: All nine spatial regions were inspected at 200% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: The composition is coherent and detailed, while city walls and towers, port structures, triangular rocky marks, and portions of the coast show directional height cues.

review_views.label: 400%拡大
review_views.evidence: The circular city, lower-left port, eastern highland, forest, delta, and southern coast were inspected in focused crops at 400% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: The city has visible wall and tower facades and a raised center; port buildings and piers retain side faces and posts; some peaks and coast marks have light-facing and dark-facing sides.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: A complete 3x3 scan covered the full canvas without gaps at enlarged scale.
review_views.notes: No generated text, watermark, frame, floating underside, broken road or river, or edge seam was found. The single disqualifying issue is residual perspective and pictorial height.

review_views.label: Candidate B1画風との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate B1 and H4 were compared at native size, 25%, 50%, and enlarged detail views.
review_views.notes: H4 preserves B1's parchment, restrained sepia, olive, and dusty-blue palette, copperplate line character, and micro-detail while successfully removing B1's floating islands and dominant mountain massif.

review_views.label: 外周・継ぎ目
review_views.evidence: All four outer edges and internal terrain transitions were inspected across overview and enlarged views.
review_views.notes: Edges remain frame-free and visually continuable, with no conspicuous internal generation seam.

review_views.label: 道路・河川・ベクター重畳余白
review_views.evidence: Roads, delta branches, the main river, crossings, fields, and quiet corridors were traced at native, 25%, 50%, and enlarged views.
review_views.notes: Networks remain continuous and visually distinguishable, and broad quiet corridors support future labels and POI overlays despite the dense central city.

immediate_failures.label: 文字・偽文字
immediate_failures.evidence: No text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, legend, compass, or scale bar was found in the overview or nine-region scan.

immediate_failures.label: 透かし・枠・現代物
immediate_failures.evidence: No watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, decorative corner, UI, or modern object appears.

immediate_failures.label: 浮島下面
immediate_failures.evidence: Candidate B1's floating islands and suspended undersides are removed; detached land in H4 reads as ordinary sea-level islands or delta bars.

immediate_failures.label: 側面・遠近法・方向光
immediate_failures.evidence: At 400%, the central city retains wall and tower facades, modeled roof blocks, and a raised center; the port retains oblique buildings, pier depth, and posts; triangular highland and coast marks retain directional light/dark side cues.

immediate_failures.label: 必須構成の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Open sea, low-coast placement, branching delta, forest river, circular city, port, roads, fields, right-side rocky highland, and quiet label corridors are all represented. Their residual height is classified under the perspective gate rather than as missing composition.

immediate_failures.label: 道路・河川破断
immediate_failures.evidence: Roads and river channels remain traceable through crossings, delta branches, city approaches, fields, and image edges.

immediate_failures.label: 樹木・岩・記号の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: The independent B review found visible motif families but sufficient local variation in tree, scrub, field, and rocky marks to avoid an immediate-failure classification; the automated audit also found no duplicated exact pixel blocks at tested scales.

immediate_failures.label: 目立つ端継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: No border, abrupt edge strip, internal tile join, or conspicuous discontinuity was found along any outer edge.

scores.label: Prompt構成・厳密平面性
scores.notes: All requested regions and networks are present and B1's floating islands and dominant mountain range are removed, but city, port, coast, and rocky marks still violate strict orthographic projection.

scores.label: 親画像・Candidate B1画風連続性
scores.notes: Parchment grain, restrained sepia, olive, and dusty-blue palette, delicate copperplate linework, and high micro-detail closely match Candidate B1.

scores.label: 端部・継ぎ目連続性
scores.notes: The plate is frame-free, internally coherent, and visually continuable through all four edges.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Material, palette, and hand-inked density are highly coherent; only the residual pictorial-height grammar conflicts with the requested flat GIS vocabulary.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Forest, scrub, water, rocky terrain, roads, city, port, and fields retain exceptional native-size micro-detail without losing reduced-scale hierarchy.

scores.label: 生成破綻・非反復性
scores.notes: No generated text, malformed structure, seam, or exact large clone appears; recurring terrain motifs remain a minor quality deduction but do not reach the B review's immediate-failure threshold.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads, rivers, city approaches, fields, open water, and quiet corridors remain clear; the dense city and highland reduce some small-label flexibility.

summary: H4 strongly preserves Candidate B1's material, restrained palette, copperplate character, exceptional micro-detail, edge continuity, and reduced-scale readability while removing B1's floating islands and dominant mountain massif. It is not Golden-ready because 400% inspection still reveals prohibited side faces, modeled height, and directional light/dark cues in the city, port, coast, and rocky highland. The single perspective immediate-failure gate disqualifies it, and the 88 score remains below the required 94.
required_changes: Redraw the central city and lower-left port as unshaded overhead footprints only, with no wall or tower facade, raised central monument, pitched roof face, pier depth, post, directional highlight, or shadow.

Replace triangular highland and cliff-like coast depth cues with irregular flat chips, sparse non-convergent strokes, stipple, low non-directional wash, and ordinary plan-view shore boundaries while preserving H4's successful B1 material and micro-detail.
